hypothesis: Closing same-boot control for the instance-configuration sweep: the champion with every setting back at its default (build.sh restores idle states and THP). If it matches exp-cfg-control, sweep deltas are not host drift.
llm_commentary: Closing same-boot control for the 2026-10-28 instance-configuration sweep (all settings at defaults): c8a 4.61s, c8i 5.73s, c8g 6.83s, m9g 4.62s. c8i stepped from ~5.50s to 5.68-5.73s at 17:03 for both exp-cfg-xfs and this run, so the XFS "+3.3%" is a host-side event, not the file system. c8a's no-effect runs (controls, page size, jemalloc, XFS) average 4.67s (4.54-4.84); idle states off measured 4.57s, ~-2% against that, consistent with yesterday's -3.0%, so the C2 effect on EPYC 9R45 is real but small (~2-3%). Graviton (c8g, m9g) has no cpuidle states; every other lever here (MDBX page size, read-tx timeout, jemalloc percpu arenas, XFS vs tmpfs) is neutral on all four families, and CPU pinning is harmful except a marginal c8a gain.
